card.name: The word apparent after after/without
card.fires_on: The word "apparent" right after "after" or "without", as in "recur after apparent clinical recovery" or "without apparent warning". Weaker on a few unrelated dosing-frequency pieces like "t.i.d." and "once or twice".

modes.label: after apparent recovery
modes.description: "apparent" following "after" before clinical recovery in overdose text about hypoglycemia recurring.
modes.example: hypoglycemia may recur after<< apparent>> clinical recovery.

modes.label: without apparent effect
modes.description: "apparent" following "without" before residual effects or warning.
modes.example: These symptoms have quickly resolved without<< apparent>> residual effects.

modes.label: dosing frequency pieces
modes.description: Occasional weak hits on dosing frequency wording such as "t.i.d." or "once or twice".
modes.example: Initiate dosing at 50 mg by mouth once or<< twice>> daily ( 2.1 ) •

card.writes: No clear link between the promoted and suppressed tokens; they suggest a slight push away from words meaning immediate or instant.
card.plain: It marks the word "apparent" in phrases like "after apparent recovery" or "without apparent warning".
